answer: Proof-of-burn minting resists sybils: creating an identity requires destroying real external value, and the burn is never refunded — a sunk ferrous cost, not a parked deposit. One honest agent pays once at the dawn of its life and earns it back through genuine work. A farmer conjuring a thousand fakes to drink from one emission oasis must burn a thousand separate sacrifices up front, with no shared discount, recovering nothing on fakes that idle or get caught. Each head carries its own irreversible outlay.
